In this role, you will a Java backend developer (Senior/Lead). You will help Java back-end team and work in project team with other sub-teams (front-end, mobile, DevOps, BA) and partner closely with our clients on a wide variety of collaborative and innovative engagements.
 
One should be a phenomenal teammate with a forward-thinking mindset, ability and confidence to challenge the status quo to define future visions.
